chapter_summary: Attention brings recognition and scrutiny. She discovers that visibility is not a cure for erasure, only a different risk.

spatality.place: the completed wall, now with people in front of it
spatality.route: from the wall to the lane and out of the courtyard
spatality.texture: attention like heat, a hand on the shoulder, the wall too bright to look at directly

poetic_parameters.movement: Confessionalism — exposure without anaesthetic, here the discovery that being seen is not being known.
writing_skills: visceral bodily register for social exposure
a close that refuses the consolation of arrival
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a hand resting on her shoulder while the wall gets all the looking
poetic_parameters.volta: from expecting recognition to feel like rescue to finding it merely changes the shape of the risk
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: breathy h and the repeated short i of seen, still, this, tightening the throat
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: restless lines that shift direction mid-clause, then stop on one blunt short line
poetic_parameters.variety_note: Chapter twenty-seven refused an explanation; this poem admits the private cost of the refusal, and is the rawest poem in the book.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: light that exposes rather than warms; skin under inspection
poetic_parameters.address: the self, in the second person, at the moment of being looked at
poetic_parameters.closing_move: visibility named as a different risk, not a cure, in the final flat line
